changelog:
- Adds the initial `oo-edenai` skill for operating Eden AI through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Uses the `oo` CLI with server-side credential injection, avoiding direct handling of raw Eden AI tokens.
- Supports live schema inspection before each action to build valid JSON payloads.
- Provides actions to list available Eden AI models and create non-streaming OpenAI-compatible chat completions.
- Documents safety expectations for read and write actions plus first-time setup recovery steps.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@0fdcf2d`
summary: Eden AI (edenai.co). Use this skill for ANY Eden AI request — reading, creating, and updating data. Whenever a task involves Eden AI, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
